verdict.rationale: Microsoft 365 Copilot docs say Copilot Chat is available inside Teams and can be grounded in the user's work data via Microsoft Graph and Work IQ, so you can ask an AI about your own data inside Teams. The Teams platform also lists suggested actions and prompt starters, but those are building blocks developers use to create agents, not built-in insights. The evidence is a few overview mentions, with nothing showing proactive insights or suggestions generated from Teams content. Missing for 10: documentation of specific AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from Teams data (e.g., summaries, recommendations), detail on how Copilot in Teams uses chat and meeting data, clarity on licensing or availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
